Input reference is STYLE ONLY: match its premium hand-painted fantasy combat VFX, textured organic brush strokes, translucent pigment, torn smoky edges, richly luminous cores and restrained soft glow. No vector line icons, flat badges, plastic 3D or pixel art. TRUE transparent alpha outside the effect. EXACTLY FOUR isolated frames arranged in a precise 2 by 2 equal-cell grid on a SQUARE canvas. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each effect is SMALL, contained in the CENTRAL 60 percent of its cell, leaving at least20 percent totally TRANSPARENT margin on ALL FOUR sides of EVERY cell; keep all glow, wisps and particles contained. The center of every frame stays at the exact cell center. Nothing touches the outer canvas edges or crosses the grid midlines. NO text, labels, borders, panels, characters, scenery, floor, UI or additional effects. One coherent effect animated across four separate cells. Character: VAMPIRA. Effect: blood-red occult rose petals and sweeping crimson crescents around a compact dark magical center. FOUR chronological phases: frame1 small faint anticipation; frame2 opening impact, full readable shape; frame3 peak contact, slightly extended painted energy; frame4 dissipating remnants, smaller broken brush trails. Preserve effect identity and direction across the sequence.
